name: EXM_MERCHANTS
description: This table contains information about merchants for employee expenses.

columns.name: MERCHANT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a merchant for an employee expense.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date that merchant is active in the application.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Last date that merchant is active in the application.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: MERCHANT_CODE
columns.description: Alphanumeric identifier of this merchant.

columns.name: MERCHANT_NAME
columns.description: Name of this merchant.

columns.name: MERCHANT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of service this merchant provides such as 'AIR', 'HOTEL', 'VEHICLE RENTAL', 'RAIL'.

columns.name: MERCHANT_WEBSITE_LINK
columns.description: Link to this merchant's website.

columns.name: MERCHANT_POLICY_LINK
columns.description: Link to this merchant's policy, such as air travel, hotel stay or vehicle rental.
